draft_en.subject: PoE switches next to MikroTik and Ubiquiti in your Kazan shop - 8 or 24?
draft_en.body:
Hi Alexander,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 14 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switch category next to MikroTik and Ubiquiti, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5. SFP modules and PoE power supplies we do not carry; EAC stays on your side. You have my WhatsApp as well if that is quicker.

One question: which port count sells more in Kazan - 8 or 24?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
